plugins.name: compact-ready
plugins.description: Before compaction, in Claude Code, Cowork and the claude.ai chat: finish the current plan stage or stop where your decision is needed, save a handoff file, and print what comes next - the /compact line with a focus, or how to continue where there is no /compact.

plugins.name: compact-ready-context
plugins.description: Add-on for Compact Ready: gives /compact-ready the context figures, adds the words context-left and context-compact, and in Cowork compacts with the handoff's focus. Needs the compact-ready plugin.
